name: onshape-native
description: A reverse-engineered native Onshape API and MCP server with a browser extension.

interface.shortDescription: Native CAD commands and REST through your signed-in browser.
interface.longDescription: Discover current REST operations, query exact geometry, edit native features and assemblies, and use bounded UI fallback only when a backend command is unavailable. Requires the local extension and a signed-in Onshape session.
defaultPrompt: Use Onshape Native to inspect and edit the model at this Onshape link or in my current Onshape tab.
